pages.text:
Spend some quality time surrounded by quality.
Autobahn shown in Titan Black leather
Design and quality. Quality can be hard to find. But in a Golf GTI, quality is sitting right
in front of you. Under you. And all around you. From the available performance package
with red brake calipers, aggressive 18" wheels, and available LED Daytime Running
Lights, to the leather-wrapped sport steering wheel, the Golf GTI puts you at the center
of it all. No wonder it was named one of Ward’s® 10 Best Interiors. So take a seat, and
take a step up in quality.
